- [ ] Bug fix

## Checklist

- [ ] I did not include secrets, tokens, cookies, private keys, production configuration, database dumps, or user data.
- [ ] I updated documentation when behavior or configuration changed.
- [ ] I kept third-party licensing compatible and documented any new dependency or asset.
- [ ] I checked PHP syntax for changed PHP files.
- [ ] I considered sanitization, escaping, nonce verification, and capability checks.
- [ ] I described security impact for changes touching login, upload, payment, orders, user data, remote requests, or permissions.
